hostStrings.original: "Could not locate the Claude CLI on PATH. Launching by name in a PowerShell terminal would run a 'claude' from the open folder instead of the installed CLI, so the launch was blocked. Make sure the Claude CLI's install directory is on your system PATH (not only your PowerShell profile), then restart VS Code and try again. VS Code reads PATH when it starts, so PATH changes take effect only after a restart."
hostStrings.chinese: "无法在 PATH 中定位 Claude CLI。如果按名称在 PowerShell 终端中启动，将会运行当前打开文件夹中的 “claude”，而不是已安装的 CLI，因此已阻止启动。请确保 Claude CLI 的安装目录位于系统 PATH 中（而不只是 PowerShell 配置文件中），然后重启 VS Code 并重试。VS Code 在启动时读取 PATH，因此 PATH 的更改仅在重启后生效。"

claude-code-walkthrough.title: 开始使用 Claude Code
claude-code-walkthrough.description: 了解如何使用 Claude Code 编写、编辑和理解你的代码。

welcome.title: 你的 AI 编程伙伴
welcome.description: Claude Code 帮助你在 VS Code 中直接编写、编辑和理解代码。

open-claude.title: 打开 Claude Code
open-claude.description: 点击右上角的橙色 Claude 图标，或按 Ctrl+Escape（Mac 上为 Cmd+Escape）开始对话。

chat.title: 与 Claude 聊天
chat.description: 输入消息并按 Enter。你可以提问、请求修改，或获取代码理解方面的帮助。使用 @ 提及文件以提供上下文，或先选中代码再就此提问。

sessions.title: 历史对话
sessions.description: 点击顶部的“历史对话”按钮，或输入 /resume 浏览过去的会话。你也可以随时点击“新建对话”按钮开始新对话。

step1.md.original: **Claude Code helps you write, edit, and understand code right in VS Code.**
step1.md.chinese: **Claude Code 帮助你在 VS Code 中直接编写、编辑和理解代码。**

step1.md.original: Claude can read your files, make edits, run terminal commands, and help you navigate complex codebases. It understands context and works alongside you like a knowledgeable teammate.
step1.md.chinese: Claude 可以读取你的文件、进行编辑、运行终端命令，并帮助你浏览复杂的代码库。它能理解上下文，像一位知识渊博的队友一样与你协作。

step1.md.original: Prefer a terminal experience? Run **Claude Code: Open in Terminal** from the Command Palette, or enable it permanently in Settings.
step1.md.chinese: 更喜欢终端体验？在命令面板中运行 **Claude Code: 在终端中打开**，或在设置中永久启用。

step2.md.original: **Click the orange Claude icon in the top right corner of your editor.**
step2.md.chinese: **点击编辑器右上角的橙色 Claude 图标。**

step2.md.original: You can also use the keyboard shortcut **Ctrl+Escape** (Windows/Linux) or **Cmd+Escape** (Mac) to quickly open or focus Claude Code.
step2.md.chinese: 你也可以使用快捷键 **Ctrl+Escape**（Windows/Linux）或 **Cmd+Escape**（Mac）快速打开或聚焦 Claude Code。

step3.md.original: **Ask questions, request changes, or get help understanding your code.**
step3.md.chinese: **提问、请求修改，或获取代码理解方面的帮助。**

step3.md.original: Type your message in the input field and press Enter. Claude can help you:
step3.md.chinese: 在输入框中输入消息并按 Enter。Claude 可以帮助你：

step3.md.original: Use **@** to mention specific files or folders for context. You can also highlight text in your editor and ask Claude about your selection.
step3.md.chinese: 使用 **@** 提及特定文件或文件夹以提供上下文。你也可以在编辑器中高亮文本，并让 Claude 针对所选内容作答。

step4.md.original: **Access your chat history and start new conversations anytime.**
step4.md.chinese: **随时访问聊天历史并开始新对话。**

step4.md.original: Your conversations are saved automatically. Click the **Past Conversations** button at the top or type **/resume** to browse past sessions and pick up where you left off.
step4.md.chinese: 你的对话会自动保存。点击顶部的 **历史对话** 按钮，或输入 **/resume** 浏览过去的会话，并从中断处继续。

step4.md.original: To start a fresh conversation, click the **New Chat** button. You can also enable the **Ctrl+N** / **Cmd+N** shortcut in settings (`claudeCode.enableNewConversationShortcut`).
step4.md.chinese: 要开始新对话，请点击 **新建对话** 按钮。你也可以在设置中启用 **Ctrl+N** / **Cmd+N** 快捷键（`claudeCode.enableNewConversationShortcut`）。
